Groza 5.45 Conversion.info: A experimental conversion kit for the OTs-14 'Groza' that allows it to chamber and fire 5.45x39mm. It was never adopted simply because it was redundant compared to 7.62x39mm performance out of a shorter barrel. Average range performance and comes with a 45rd magazine!

ECR .458 Conversion.info:
Loads your ECR with .458 SOCOM.
Lower damage, but significantly improved recoil and magazine capacity.

Uzi .22LR Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .22 Long Rifle.
Stats similar to the ZIP22... But in full auto! Why would you do this?
Comes with a specially made 50 round Promag!

FT300 22LR.info:
Load your FT300 with the .22 Long Rifle cartridge.
This ammo type deals poorer damage in long range to the body and limbs, but still competes due to a fast reload and surprisingly high torso damage. Does not pair with the Marksman Kit and will always single load ammunition. No reserve ammo.

AKM .366 (Buckshot).info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are rounds with small pellets inside of them.

Henry 30-30 Conversion.info:
Converts your Henry 45-70 into the Henry 30-30, firing .30-30 Winchester.
Holds an extra round of ammunition with more accuracy, but less performance in some areas. Faster action.

M855 Specialty Conversion.info:
Load your M231 with M855 5.56x45mm NATO.
 housed in a modified 100-round Beta-C double drum. They tumble quickly after leaving the barrel, causing inaccuracies when firing. An aura of sadness surrounds this conversion. It's as if a fallen hero once wielded this weapon...

HAMR 6.8SPC Conversion.info: Change the ammunition fired from your HAMR IAR to 6.8x43mm SPC. Improved damage output at the cost of recoil control.

FT300 Extended Magazine.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 10 rounds combined with a straight pull bolt, but lessen certain mobility traits.

CMARS 9x30 Conversion.info:
Load your MARS with 9x30mm MARS, a cartridge made from a necked down 10mm Magnum round.

Possesses high stopping power up close, but falls off at longer ranges.

Vector 357 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your Vector into .357 SIG.
I hope you weren't expecting an easy ride with this conversion...

VPO .366 (Slugs).info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are rounds with small pellets inside of them.

AUG 40 S&W Conversion.info:
Converts your UAR A3 PARA into the AUG 40 firing the .40 S&W cartridge.
Lower fire rate while increasing CQC damage, range and penetration but has a weaker ranged damage and bullet speed.

S-12U 9MM Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12U with 9x19mm.
Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

SVU 953 Conversion.info:
Load your SVU with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 A much large Zarovian caliber designed for the general public. Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

SCAR-H 7.62 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MK17 SOCOM into 6.5 Creedmoor.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

.223 Blanks.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with .223 Remington blank rounds! These being weaker cartridges will hurt your projecticles range performance, hurting velocity and damage ranges. But fret not! For you have a 50 round drum!

HAMR 9mm Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your HAMR IAR into 9x19mm using a conversion kit by Big Woods MFG.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

556 STG.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your STG into 5.56x45mm NATO making it the ''STG-N'' with a 60 round casket magazine.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.
You have defiled history.

1858 Snake Shot.info: Changes your shot load into a special purpose pellet-loaded 357 magnum round. Six almost buckshot sized pellets that are great for putting pesky soldier vermin.

GSP 32 S&W.info: Convert your GSP into the GSP-C, firing the .32 S&W Long round. It is perfect for those who can't seem to land headshots.

e Shotgun Light Discs.info: Lightweight 'pancakes' that improve the bullet speed but decrease accuracy, supppresion, and increases spread.

BIZON 9x18mm Conversion.info:
Loads your PP-19 BIZON with 9x18mm Makarov.
 Larger magazine and less recoil, but slower and less damaging bullets. Not optimal for ranged encounters.

K7 5.56x45 Conversion.info:
Load your K7 with 5.56x45mm NATO.
With some expert gunsmithing you managed to successfully change the round of which your K7 fires to be of the more common 5.56x45mm NATO. Giving performance which fits more a carbine, but is louder due to the nature of this cartridge not being subsonic.

MCX Spear 6.5 Creedmoor.info: Converts your weapon to fire 6.5mm Creedmoor. Uses a 25rd magazine and improves recoil but lowers overall damage and penetration performance!
